precise_edge_drag.title: Immediate short clip-edge corrections
precise_edge_drag.response: Use shared drag-only targets on real clip edges so sub6pixel corrections and the final release endpoint are applied, with zero-motion, source-bound, group, fade, snap and single-Undo guards. Preserve body-click selection and group dragging.
precise_edge_drag.acceptance: Short audio/MIDI edge drags apply their final snapped/free position; an unmoved edge press does not edit; group/body/fade behavior and one Undo per gesture remain correct.

midi_release_position.title: Apply the final MIDI pointer position on release
midi_release_position.response: Process the final released-frame pointer location for active MIDI gestures as well as button-down updates, with a regression that distinguishes the before/after behavior.
midi_release_position.acceptance: A running-app before/after scenario demonstrates the dropped final-position bug and its correction. This addresses a confirmed code path consistent with P4, while the exact cause of that native participant gesture remains unproven.

loop_and_clip_identity.title: Clarify playback looping and repeated clip identity
loop_and_clip_identity.response: Use explicit Loop playback over clip/selection/arrangement wording and clarify that Repeat creates copies. Extend the existing full-name hover with track and start/end position so equally named repeated clips can be distinguished.
loop_and_clip_identity.acceptance: Visible wording separates playback range from clip creation; hover identifies full clip/track name and exact location without changing project/history.

native_causality_limit: The released-frame bug is verified in application code and will receive running-app regression evidence; it is not asserted to explain every observed native note-length difference.

corrected_targets.scope: Only this target section; earlier failures of another target in the same log remain retained.

implementation_limits.scope: Entire edge gesture coalesced into one frame
implementation_limits.limit: When press, move and release all arrive in one frame and end outside the edge hit area, the toolkit accepts no edge target. This case is safely left unchanged. Ordinary outward drags and accepted inward batched drags pass.

implementation_limits.behavior: A press used to dismiss an open menu/popup cannot begin the custom trim gesture.

An icon-only tiny clip is legitimate at extreme widths. The test was corrected after measuring geometry; no production UI change was made to force text into that clip. Full identity remains in the hover.
